title: Alabama Could Overtake Texas in CFP Standings by Beating Georgia
seoTitle: Alabama Could Pass Texas in CFP With Georgia Win
subtitle: A win over Georgia could put the Crimson Tide ahead of the Longhorns
excerpt: With a win over Georgia, Alabama has a chance to pass Texas in the College Football Playoff rankings, according to the CBS resume ranking.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Alabama is close to overtaking Texas in the College Football Playoff (CFP) rankings if it beats Georgia this week. The team has already climbed from fourth to second in the resume rankings after defeating Mississippi State.

How the CFP resume ranking works

The system assigns a numerical value between 0 and 1 to each win, based on the opponent's ranking in the CBS Sports 138 and the location of the game. A home win against the No. 2 ranked team, like Georgia, yields an addition of +0.89 to Alabama's resume.

Impact of a win over Georgia

If Alabama defeats Georgia, the jump in points could be enough for the Crimson Tide to overtake Texas, which currently holds the top spot. The +0.89 gain represents one of the largest possible boosts in the system.

Consequences of a loss

An Alabama loss to Georgia would result in a small deduction of -0.11 on its resume, reflecting that an average team ranked 25th would lose at home to the second-ranked team 89% of the time.

Comparison with other recent results

While a Texas loss to Oklahoma wouldn't bring much benefit to its resume, Alabama's victory over a highly ranked opponent carries significant weight. On the other hand, an Ohio State loss at home to Maryland, ranked 73rd, would deal a -0.87 blow, which is much more severe.

What is at stake for the CFP

The resume ranking determines positions for the playoff, and every game against elite teams can drastically alter the hierarchy. With the matchup against Georgia, Alabama has the opportunity to solidify its spot among the top two teams.

With information from CBS Sports.
